description: Post the signed-in person's review of a title under their name. The review text must be the person's own words (ask them for it; do not write it for them); it is shown with a "via an assistant" label. One review per title; posting again replaces it. Needs sign-in.

title.description: Title as the person said it, or a slug from search results
